target: Spoiler-free complete play of the original PS2 release: all mission objectives, performance records, ranks, ratings, awards, equipment, and preserved co-op requirements

areas.name: Run Setup
areas.location_cue: The title screen and agent dossier before the first deployment.
areas.note: This route uses the original North American PlayStation 2 release through PCSX2.

levels.1: Keep the 2004 release as the content authority.
levels.2: Load a verified personal North American PS2 disc dump in PCSX2.
levels.3: Use a verified personal ISO dump with a dedicated virtual memory card. Internal-resolution scaling and texture filtering are presentation changes only; avoid patches or codes that alter objectives, rank points, timers, or inventory.

levels.1: Protect the dossier before long rating grinds.
levels.2: Use one dedicated virtual card and rotate mission-start states.
levels.3: Confirm a normal dossier save reloads before starting. Keep memory-card saves as the permanent record, retain a clean state at each mission briefing, and make a separate backup before online sessions or emulator updates.

levels.1: Some completion records require partners.
levels.2: Use PCSX2 networking with the current PS Rewired service and arrange co-op partners.
levels.3: As of 2026-07-28, PS Rewired lists the NTSC release as supported. Enable PCSX2 DEV9 networking, use the service's current DNS rather than an old hard-coded address, create a separate network profile, and schedule partners before attempting team-only objectives or the nine team pars.

levels.1: Separate solo completion from preserved-network completion.
levels.2: Finish every solo objective and deadline even if partners are temporarily unavailable.
levels.3: A solo-only dossier can reach Commander C6 but cannot legitimately reach T4 because team objectives and team-par ratings contribute required points. Mark the online branch pending rather than using save edits or fake lobby flags.

levels.1: Count obtainable retail content, not dormant developer data.
levels.2: Exclude beta weapons that require external memory codes.
levels.3: The disc contains unused and incomplete equipment entries, but they are not awarded by normal play and do not persist without external manipulation. They are recorded in the internal audit only and are not requirements for a legitimate dossier.
